hypothesis: Remove per-image word-vector reconstruction and predicted text length. Train a fixed continuous visual prefix in the audio domain so training and inference share a continuous visual representation.
evidence: Both wider prefix regression and its final-attention LoRA variant reproduce training speech but fail exposed development ASR; codec0-greedy also fails. More capacity at the same sentence-vector regression interface has not solved transfer. The earlier matched M1 CE ablation diverged from teacher distributions, whereas KL plus mixed decoding yielded human-accepted speech. Preserve that verified recipe rather than fitting one stochastic codec path.
reader: Global image residual MLP width256, fixed32 continuous positions. Initialize its output bias to a previously learned mostly-intelligible M1 numeric speech prefix; zero image output weights initially. This shared numeric anchor is an initialization, not an inference transcript or per-image sentence target.
data: Same170 image-specific genuine codec targets and cached768D features; existing55 development vectors; no new image labeling or reserved96 access. Training loads no sentence-prefix target tensors.
comparison: Two independent runs, frozen Talker versus same rank8 alpha8 last4 q/v LoRA; identical fresh reader initialization fingerprints, same data/seed/schedule. Both begin from the numeric anchor, not the fitted sentence-vector reader.
training: Codec0 KL including EOS plus residual-codebook KL against frozen matched teacher distributions on gold previous16 codes; residual weight1 as in the accepted M1 language control. No prefix MSE or text-length loss. Reader and optional LoRA lr1e-4, warm20 cosine floor0.1 over1600 steps; actual800 resume; joint normclip1.
evaluation: Both models on original4 exposed development inputs, first training input and null; codec0 greedy with sampled residuals seed42 cap160, matching the accepted M1 mixed-decoding control; same numeric inputs, no teacher/text/label files read.
limits: All results development only. Constant-anchor repetition is failure, not grounding. Training loss is diagnostic only. Human listening required for claimed Italian/grounding success. No publication of private media/labels/weights, no paid job.
teacher: Cache frozen original Qwen policies using training-only exact prefixes and genuine gold codes; detach and checksum logits. Student training consumes only audio distributions/codes and image features, plus its shared numeric initialization anchor. No per-image sentence-prefix targets are reconstructed or loaded by the student.
